brief:
Israeli forces concluded an 11-day military operation in Hebron, during which troops looted and vandalized Palestinian residences, Middle East Eye reported. Residents returned to damaged homes stripped of valuables following the assault, which displaced hundreds of people and damaged businesses across the city.

The raid left widespread destruction in its wake as Palestinian families surveyed the extent of losses to their property and possessions.

title: Israeli army ends 11-day Hebron raid after looting Palestinian homes
